payload.comment: Profiling stage is clean. All deterministic checks pass with no findings. Key verifications: (1) Archive MD5 a8b06965200029087d5bd730944a56c1 matches the verified hash; SHA256 recorded. (2) Loaded split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) exactly match official PathMNIST sizes. (3) Image shape 28×28×3 RGB, 9-class multi-class — consistent with the standard MedMNIST distribution. (4) No duplicate train samples, zero blank images, full profiled fraction (1.0). (5) Class proportions between train and val are nearly identical (max absolute deviation < 0.0001), confirming no split-level distribution mismatch. (6) Imbalance ratio 1.63 is modest; channel statistics (means ≈ 0.53–0.74, stds ≈ 0.12–0.18) are reasonable for RGB histology patches. (7) Ambiguity risks (background/debris/mucus overlap, adipose vs. background, smooth muscle vs. stroma, etc.) are well-documented and expected at 28×28 resolution — informational, not blocking. (8) Test set originates from CRC-VAL-HE-7K (different clinical center), a known domain-shift property of PathMNIST; test_imbalance_ratio=1.0 and empty test_to_train_prevalence_ratio are consistent with this design. Minor informational note: llm_model_digest is null for 'qwen3.8', which weakens full content-addressed reproducibility of any LLM-assisted downstream steps; this is non-blocking but should be tracked. No deterministic issues, no critical or warning-level findings. Pipeline may proceed to the next stage.
